purpose: Slide-local domain ledger for functional operations preserving convexity.

operations.convexity_condition: alpha_i >= 0 and each f_i is convex
operations.domain_rule: finite only on the common finite domain, unless zero coefficients remove terms
operations.watch: avoid undefined extended-real combinations such as +infinity plus -infinity

operations.convexity_condition: g convex and A affine-linear in x
operations.watch: rank loss changes geometry but not convexity

operations.domain_rule: points where the supremum is finite; contained in the common finite domain
operations.watch: active index may switch with x

operations.domain_rule: projection of dom h onto y
operations.watch: value can be -infinity without properness or coercivity hypotheses
properness may fail when the infimum is -infinity

operations.convexity_condition: f convex and lambda > 0, with closed extension handled separately
operations.domain_rule: {(lambda,x) : lambda > 0 and x/lambda in dom f}
operations.watch: the lambda = 0 boundary is a recession/cone bookkeeping issue
